paths.description: Source image files to combine, in frame order (2-20 of .png, .jpg, .jpeg, .webp, .bmp). All must be the same width and height.

outputPath.description: Where to write the combined .gif file. Must not already exist.

frameDelayMs.description: Milliseconds each frame is shown before advancing to the next. Defaults to 500.

loop.description: Whether the GIF loops forever (true) or plays once and stops (false). Defaults to true.
